title: Email templates
description: Manage global system email content. Tenant-specific templates and test sends are not supported.
catalogDescription: Each template is grouped by key, with every language status shown in the same row.

empty.title: No email templates
empty.description: No system email template has been registered yet.

editor.description: Edit the global system email source. HTML is stored as source only; previews and test sends are not available.
editor.variablesDescription: Selecting a variable inserts its template token at the cursor.
editor.definitionUnavailable: This template has no client variable definition. You can still edit its source; the server will validate it when saving.
editor.concurrentDraft: A draft was changed by another administrator. Your unsaved content is preserved.
editor.saveBeforePublish: Save the draft before publishing it.

publishDialog.title: Publish email template?
publishDialog.description: This publishes a new revision and archives the currently published revision. This cannot be undone.

editor.conflict: The template changed on the server. Review the latest draft before publishing.

validation.unsupportedVariable: {{field}} uses a variable that is not available for this template.

invitationUrl.label: Activation link
invitationUrl.description: Required in both plain-text and HTML bodies.

expiresAt.label: Invitation expiry
expiresAt.description: Required in both plain-text and HTML bodies.

history.title: Revision history
history.description: Archived revisions are read-only source records.

discardDialog.title: Discard unsaved changes?
discardDialog.description: Your edits have not been saved and will be lost.

errors.notFound: This email template was not found.
